overdueNote: Past the due date and not yet paid
seeDuesHint: Who owes what, and for how long
dueBeforeIssue: The due date can't be before the date.
deleteBody: It was never issued, so nothing in the books changes.
voidedBecause: Voided: {{reason}}. Its entry in the books was reversed.
undoBody: Its journal entry is reversed and the amount is due again. The record stays, marked undone.
moreThanDue: That is more than is still due.
emailBody: The PDF goes as an attachment.
voidBody: Its entry in the books is reversed and it no longer counts as owed. It can't be undone.
duesSubtitle: Money still owed on invoices and bills, by how long it has been due.
agingChart: What is owed, by how late it is
sale_subtitle: Bills you send to customers. Issuing one records the sale; their payments clear it.
sale_emptyHint: Make an invoice for a sale on credit, then record the money when it comes in.
sale_referenceHint: The customer's PO or order number, if they gave one.
sale_notesHint: Printed on the invoice: payment details, thanks, terms.
sale_issueNote: Issuing gives it a number and records the sale in the books. After that it can't be changed, only voided.
sale_paymentsAfterIssue: Payments can be recorded once the invoice is issued.
sale_nothingOwedHint: Unpaid invoices show here, by customer.
bill_subtitle: Bills from suppliers. Entering one records what you owe; paying it clears it.
bill_emptyHint: Enter a supplier's bill when it arrives, then record the payment when you pay it.
bill_referenceHint: As written on their bill, to find it later.
bill_notesHint: For yourself: what it covers, who approved it.
bill_issueNote: Recording gives it a number and puts what you owe in the books. After that it can't be changed, only voided.
bill_paymentsAfterIssue: Payments can be recorded once the bill is recorded.
bill_nothingOwedHint: Unpaid bills show here, by supplier.
vatIntoCost: The business isn't VAT-registered, so this VAT is counted as part of the cost.
vatNotClaimed: This bill's VAT is part of the cost: the business wasn't VAT-registered when it was recorded.
vatSettingsHint: Whether this business charges VAT on its invoices.
vatRegisteredHint: Invoices can then charge VAT, and VAT on bills can be claimed back. Without it, VAT on bills counts as part of the cost.
defaultVatRate: Rate new invoice lines start with
vatSubtitle: VAT charged on sales and VAT you can claim back on bills, for a month.
vatNotRegistered: This business isn't marked as VAT-registered, so its invoices don't charge VAT.
vatCarryForwardNote: More VAT paid than charged this month
vatNoDocuments: No issued invoices or bills this month.
vatDisclaimer: A help for the monthly VAT return (Mushak 9.1), worked out from issued invoices and bills. It doesn't include sales or purchases recorded only as transactions, and it isn't filed for you. Check it before submitting.
